messages.subject: Project Harbor — pre-completion items (VAT/TOGC)
messages.plaintextBody:
Rebecca,

For the TOGC treatment to hold, Thornbury needs, before completion, to: (a) be VAT-registered (confirmed); (b) opt to tax Maritime Quarter and notify HMRC; and (c) confirm the capital goods scheme article doesn't apply. We've prepared the option to tax notification — can you arrange signature this week? We'll notify HMRC on 19 Feb.

James
